title: Oct 7 Results + Oct 8 Preview: When the Favorites Don't Show Up
summary: A humbling 1-3 day on Oct 7, but we're bouncing back with Oct 8's White Sox pick

content.value:
## Here's the Thing About Baseball

Some days, the favorites just don't show up. And October 7th? Well, that was one of those days. We went 1-3, hitting on just 25% of our picks, and honestly, it stings a little. The Dodgers came through for us against the Braves, but the Sox, Yankees, and Padres all had other plans. That's the beauty and the heartbreak of this game—nothing is ever guaranteed.

## Breaking Down Yesterday's Action

Let's not shy away from what happened. The only bright spot was our Dodgers pick at 51% confidence—they delivered. But the three misses? Those hurt. The Sox couldn't get it done against the Guardians despite being our 50% pick. The Yankees fell short against the Rays at 52%. And the Padres, our most confident pick at 54%, couldn't close the deal against the Brewers.

Days like this remind you that baseball is a marathon, not a sprint. One rough day doesn't define a season of picks.

## Looking Ahead to October 8

Here's where we dust ourselves off and get back to work. Tomorrow brings us another shot at the Guardians-White Sox matchup, and interestingly, we're sticking with the White Sox again at 50% confidence. Some might call that stubborn. I call it conviction.

The pitching matchup features Parker Messick taking the mound for Cleveland against Chicago's Hagen Smith. It's a battle of arms that could go either way, which explains that coin-flip confidence level. But there's something about the White Sox's home setup that keeps pulling our model back to them.

## The Bounce-Back Mentality

You know what separates good handicappers from great ones? It's not about never having a bad day—everyone has those. It's about how you respond. Do you panic and abandon your process? Or do you trust the numbers, learn from the misses, and come back ready to compete?

We're choosing option two. The model that's served us well all season doesn't become useless after one rough Tuesday. We'll analyze what went wrong, make any necessary adjustments, and trust that over the long haul, good process leads to good results.

So yeah, 1-3 hurts. But October 8 is a new day, and we've got a White Sox team we believe in. Let's see if they can reward that faith this time around.
